text:
Marta L.: Heads-up — Q4 APAC edge capacity planning thread. We need a concrete proposal for hosted API capacity in APAC for Oct–Dec: buy vs 12mo leases vs cloud burst. Key constraints: limited rack power in SG, infra budget cap, and a product marketing holiday push (expected traffic spike).

Kevin H.: quick numbers from usage signals: last quarter APAC consumed ~350k GPU-hours. Marketing+holiday bump modeling (+2.0x peak, +1.4x avg) => base Q4 demand ~490k, surge scenario ~980k GPU-hours.

Sanjay R.: +1 on the surge model but add 20% overhead for cache warming + A/B rollouts. So plan for 1.18M GPU-hours in the worst-case. Tail latency is the killer — we need spare headroom for short bursts.

Hana K.: cost tradeoffs (ballpark):
- Buy (A100-80GB equiv): ~$12.5k per GPU one-time capex.
- 12mo lease: ~$1,500 / GPU / month.
- Cloud burst (on-demand GPUs): ~$6.5 / GPU-hour retails but varies by region.
We should compare fully loaded TCO over 12 months.

Liam T.: note APAC constraints: single colo in SG has 6U power per rack limit, max 40 GPUs/rack for our server design. Procurement lead times for bought cards + chassis ~8–12 weeks.

Marta L.: proposal idea: mixed strategy — buy enough to cover steady baseline, 12mo leases for predictable peak capacity, cloud for short high-cost bursts. Want concrete counts and budget ask by EOD Friday.

Kevin H.: rough sizing calc I used:
```
# rough Q4 capacity calc
expected_q4_gpu_hours = 750000  # conservative mid/surge blend
avg_utilization = 0.60
hours_per_gpu_q4 = 24 * 90 * avg_utilization  # 90 days in quarter
gpus_needed = ceil(expected_q4_gpu_hours / hours_per_gpu_q4)
# numbers -> hours_per_gpu_q4 = 1296, gpus_needed ≈ 580
```
So ~580 GPUs if we want to serve the blended scenario at 60% util; worst-case (1.18M) -> ~910 GPUs.

Sanjay R.: 60% util is optimistic for hosted API given KV cache misses and multi-model mix. Recommend planning buys for 40% util steady-state and leases for another 30% to keep latency headroom. That yields: buys ~970*0.4=388, leases ~970*0.3=291 for worst-case.

Hana K.: translating to cost (worst-case 910 GPUs over Q4):
- Buy 388 GPUs -> capex ≈ 388 * $12.5k = $4.85M (one-time).
- Lease 291 GPUs for 3 months -> 291 * $1.5k * 3 = $1.309M.
- Cloud burst (reserve 231 GPUs worth of slack) -> assume 2,000 burst hours total * $6.5 = $13k.
Total Q4 incremental spend roughly $6.17M (capex+lease+burst). Ops/infra should propose financing plan if we go heavy buy.

Liam T.: also factor rack/spare parts + network uplink cost. If we buy 388 GPUs we need ~10–11 racks in SG; request for floor space and power already in flight but not guaranteed.

Marta L.: alternative smaller buy: cover steady baseline at 40% of blended scenario (~232 GPUs buy) + 400 leases to cover peak for 3 months. Lower capex (~232*$12.5k=$2.9M) and higher opex. Which would yield better IRR?

Hana K.: quick ROI back-of-envelope: if we assume bought GPUs amortized over 36 months, effective monthly cost per bought GPU ≈ $12.5k / 36 ≈ $347. Lease is $1,500/mo — buy wins at 36mo horizon if utilization justifies it. But if we only need them heavily for Q4 bursts, lease/cloud is cheaper.

ops-bot: FYI — planned maintenance window in SG on 2026-10-11 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan capacity so can withstand that window.

Sanjay R.: operational ask: we need improved short-window autoscaling (1–2 minute spin) + pre-warm cache when toggling model variants. Otherwise burst capacity will not meet p99 latency SLOs.

Kevin H.: next steps I propose:
1) run a model-level utilization sim using Nov–Dec traffic traces (I can spin this up)
2) produce three scenarios: conservative, blended, worst-case with GPU counts and cost breakout
3) options: heavy-buy, mixed, lease-only with cloud-refill
I can have draft spreadsheet by Thursday.

Marta L.: perfect. please also include network uplink / rack lead time risks and a short risk matrix. We'll sync Fri 11am PT to finalize budget ask. :thumbsup:

Hana K.: will prepare capex/opex comparison slide and runway impact.

Liam T.: I'll validate rack/power feasibility with colo ops and vendor lead times.

Sanjay R.: I'll scope autoscaler and prewarm work; might need two sprints to land reliable 2min spin.

Marta L.: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for numbers. Ping here if any PoCs are needed.
